parsed.rationale: Legal team is reviewing the DPA before enabling EU customer records and requests confirmation on subprocessors, data retention, and whether support logs can include customer identifiers—privacy/DPA compliance handling needed.

parsed.draft_response:
Hello, 

Thanks for the clarification request—I've routed this to our privacy/DPA contact for handling by our compliance team. 

To help them respond accurately, could you please share:
1) The specific DPA document/version (or link/attachment) your legal team is reviewing.
2) The exact list of subprocessors and the data retention details your legal team needs confirmed (including any retention periods/criteria).
3) The language or question your legal team is using regarding support logs and whether/how customer identifiers may appear in support logs.

Once we have the above, our privacy contact will review and coordinate the appropriate written confirmation back to your legal team.

Best regards, 
Support/Compliance Routing Team
promised_actions: Reroute the ticket to the appropriate privacy/DPA contact for human review
Request the specific DPA document/version and the exact items needed for subprocessors, retention, and support log handling confirmations
safety_notes: Human review is required; response does not claim final confirmation or resolution.
Did not determine security or compliance outcome; requested the minimum clarifications needed for accurate handling.
